EmailTemplate.description: Introducing the enrollment coach and congratulating on admission.
EmailTemplate.name: Enrollment Coach Admit: No Call Contact
EmailTemplate.subject: Congratulations on your admission to Arizona State University!
EmailTemplate.textOnly:
Hello {!Contact.FirstName},
Congratulations on your admission to the {!Opportunity.Location__c} campus at Arizona State University. My name is {!User.FirstName} and I’m your personal enrollment coach. You can call me anytime at XXX-XXX-XXXX to ask questions and talk about the experience you’ll have at ASU.
I’m here for you, and I’ll be in touch to see how you’re doing throughout the rest of your college search process. I look forward to connecting soon.
{!User.FirstName} Enrollment Coach Admission Services
{!Case.Thread_Id}
